ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  HT Media Limited has announced a Board meeting for August 5, 2026, to approve its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the first quarter of FY2026-27, ended June 30, 2026. Following this, the company will host a conference call and webinar for analysts and investors on the same day to discuss these results. This is a routine regulatory disclosure under SEBI LODR Regulation 30, indicating standard corporate governance with no immediate material impacts or red flags identified in this announcement.
